metadata.technology_stack: React Native (Hermes Bytecode v98) + Native Android Java/Kotlin Components

bark_aubergine_dark.name: Bark Deep Aubergine / Midnight Plum
bark_aubergine_dark.role: Primary Dark Brand Color. Used for main app bar, primary header backgrounds, dark high-contrast typography, and primary button labels.

bark_royal_purple.name: Bark Royal Purple
bark_royal_purple.role: Primary Accent Brand Color. Used for primary CTA buttons, selected navigation items, active switch toggles, and brand focus highlights.

bark_deep_magenta.name: Bark Deep Magenta Accent
bark_deep_magenta.role: Secondary brand accent. Used for secondary action buttons, badges, and gradient terminal stops with #6A266D.

bark_vivid_magenta.name: Bark Electric Magenta
bark_vivid_magenta.role: High-visibility accent used for promotional trial banners, new feature tags, and onboarding spotlight pips.

bark_protection_teal.name: Bark Sentinel Teal / Safe Green
bark_protection_teal.role: Safety and Protection Active Status. Signifies all monitoring engines active, VPN loopback connected, and device securely paired.

bark_protection_teal_subtle.name: Bark Muted Sentinel Teal (with alpha)
bark_protection_teal_subtle.role: Subtle surface tint for safe status cards, verified permission chips, and geofence boundary fills.

bark_alert_danger_red.name: Bark Danger Red / Critical Alert
bark_alert_danger_red.role: Severe risk level indicator. Used for flagged harmful content (severe cyberbullying, self-harm, sexual content alerts) and Pause Internet status.

bark_alert_coral.name: Bark Alert Coral / Moderate Risk
bark_alert_coral.role: Moderate risk level indicator. Used for medium-severity language alerts, bedtime warnings, and caution prompts.

bark_trust_blue.name: Bark Trust Blue
bark_trust_blue.role: Informational highlights, hyperlink references, help center links, and initial device pairing instructions.

bark_google_blue.name: Bark Interactive Cyan-Blue
bark_google_blue.role: Secondary interactive elements, progress spinner bars, and connection verification indicators.

surface_page_background.name: Bark Warm Light Canvas
surface_page_background.role: Main screen background color for child and parent dashboard views, creating a soft, glare-free canvas.

surface_card_pure_white.name: Pure White Elevated Surface
surface_card_pure_white.role: Card containers, list item surfaces, bottom sheet modals, and input fields.

surface_subtle_card.name: Subtle Surface Gray
surface_subtle_card.role: Hover / pressed states on list items, secondary chip background, and inactive schedule blocks.

border_divider_subtle.name: Bark Soft Divider & Border
border_divider_subtle.role: 1px hairline dividers between table rows, card outlines, and text input borders.

border_subtle_variant.name: Standard Boundary Gray
border_subtle_variant.role: Border stroke for inactive controls, tab bar top border, and dialog outlines.

text_primary_dark.name: Bark Ink / Primary Text
text_primary_dark.role: Main body text, headlines, and critical metric numbers.

text_secondary_muted.name: Bark Slate / Secondary Text
text_secondary_muted.role: Timestamps, explanatory captions, subtitle text, and form helper descriptions.

text_placeholder.name: Placeholder Gray
text_placeholder.role: Search input placeholders, empty state instructions, and disabled control labels.

backdrop_scrim.name: Aubergine Modal Backdrop (53% Alpha)
backdrop_scrim.role: Dimming backdrop behind bottom sheets, alert detail dialogs, and permission request modals.
